query: How can I track my missing person complaint status?
reference_answer:
Tracking Missing Person Complaint Status:
You can track your missing person complaint status by visiting the Tamil Nadu Police Department's website, using the complaint number, or by contacting the police station where you filed the complaint.
answer: You can check the status of your missing person complaint by contacting the local police department where the complaint was filed. They will have the most accurate information about its current status. [Document 1]
